title: rhododendron × pennsylvanicum
intro: Rhododendron × pennsylvanicum, commonly known as the 'Pennsylvania Rhododendron' or 'Pleasant White', is a hybrid rhododendron plant known for its attractive white flowers and compact growth habit. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and vasodilatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron × pennsylvanicum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which may help in treating various health conditions. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as anthocyanins, flavonoids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
